---
title: "`r params$ticker` Price Report"
output: html_document
params:
  ticker: "TICKER"
  ticker_data: NULL
  sector_name: "Sector"
  industry_name: "Industry"
  n_sector_stocks: 0
  n_industry_stocks: 0
  valuation_data: NULL
  valuation_metric_name: "EV to NOPAT (per share)"
  valuation_n_sector_stocks: 0
  valuation_n_industry_stocks: 0
  roic_data: NULL
  roic_n_sector_stocks: 0
  roic_n_industry_stocks: 0
  anomaly_data: NULL
  drawdown_anomaly_data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r return-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cumulative_return(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$n_industry_stocks
)
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(params$ticker_data, params$ticker) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```

## Valuation

```{r valuation-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_valuation_ratio(
  params$valuation_data,
  params$ticker,
  metric_name = params$valuation_metric_name,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$valuation_n_sector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$valuation_n_industry_stocks
)
```

## Return on Invested Capital

```{r roic-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_roic(
  params$roic_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$roic_n_sector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$roic_n_industry_stocks
)
```

## Valuation Anomaly Detection

```{r anomaly-ev-nopat, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Fit elliptic envelope for EV/NOPAT
envelope_ev <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat_yoy_change,
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat,
  contamination = 0.1
)

# Create plot
plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$anomaly_data,
  x_col = "ev_nopat_yoy_change",
  y_col = "ev_nopat",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "industry",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$industry_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_ev,
  x_label = "YoY Change in EV/NOPAT",
  y_label = "EV to NOPAT (per share)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "n = ", nrow(params$anomaly_data), " stocks in ", params$sector_name,
    " sector; EV/NOPAT clipped at 100x"
  )
)
```

## ROIC vs Valuation

```{r anomaly-roic, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Fit elliptic envelope for ROIC vs EV/NOPAT
envelope_roic <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$anomaly_data$roic_pct,
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat,
  contamination = 0.1
)

# Create plot
plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$anomaly_data,
  x_col = "roic_pct",
  y_col = "ev_nopat",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "industry",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$industry_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_roic,
  x_label = "ROIC (%)",
  y_label = "EV to NOPAT (per share)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "n = ", nrow(params$anomaly_data), " stocks in ", params$sector_name, " sector"
  )
)
```

## Price Momentum Anomaly Detection

```{r anomaly-drawdown, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Fit elliptic envelope for drawdown vs TTM return
envelope_dd <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$drawdown_anomaly_data$ttm_return,
  params$drawdown_anomaly_data$drawdown_pct,
  contamination = 0.1
)

# Create plot
plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$drawdown_anomaly_data,
  x_col = "ttm_return",
  y_col = "drawdown_pct",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "industry",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$industry_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_dd,
  x_label = "TTM Return",
  y_label = "Current Drawdown (%)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "n = ", nrow(params$drawdown_anomaly_data), " stocks in ", params$sector_name, " sector"
  )
)
```
